name: Intent
measure: Share of the intent objects that conform: every intention refined by a problem, every problem addressed by an objective, every objective measured and with a need deriving from it, every need with a requirement and a validation (D-347).
description: The owner's intention, goals and locked constraints (docs/SEMENTE.md), the problems and opportunities that make them concrete, the objectives measured against a baseline and a target, and the needs that derive from them (D-347).
